mode: manual native pluginlib probe and microbenchmark

build.initialization: Initialized with a real nav2_util::LifecycleNode and null costmap; prepare accepted a two-point path

measurements.name: native bridge with constant Python score

measurement_limitations: Each timing is one aggregate run, with no repetition, distribution or confidence interval.
The harness called the native plugin through ctypes in an existing matching Python interpreter.
The measured loop includes scoreTrajectory, GIL acquisition, scalar Python argument construction and the Python score call.
Timing excludes compilation, plugin discovery, lifecycle initialization, prepare, DWB trajectory generation, other critics, costmap collision checks and Nav2 executor work.
All timed candidates were identical, valid, aligned forward candidates. Rejection and Python exception paths were probed for behavior but not timed.
These measurements do not establish a control-cycle deadline or real-time guarantee.
External controller_server initialization and navigation results are recorded separately in forward.json.
